question: Will petrol cost more in Germany on Mon 2 Nov 2026 than a week earlier (EU Weekly Oil Bulletin)?

model.prompt_context:
Resolution criteria:
- "Yes": The European Commission's Weekly Oil Bulletin consumer prices with taxes put Germany's Euro-super 95 petrol price for Monday 2026-11-02 strictly higher than for Monday 2026-10-26, in euro per litre at the published precision.
- "No": The Weekly Oil Bulletin price for Monday 2026-11-02 is equal to or lower than the price for Monday 2026-10-26.

Clarifications:
- Use the prices with taxes (consumer prices including duties and VAT).
- The Commission publishes each Monday's prices on the Thursday after (member states submit them on Wednesday).
- Euro-super 95 is regular unleaded petrol; gas oil is road diesel.
